## One MenuAPI for every server

Starting at v4.0.0, FiveM Legacy, FiveM Enhanced and RedM share one version number and are released together.

**FiveM Legacy and Enhanced are built from the same code.** Everything from MenuAPI Enhanced 1.x, like NUI menus, themes, custom banners and rebindable key bindings, now works on Legacy too.

**Menus are always drawn with NUI.** Native drawing is gone. Your resource needs an `index.html`, a `ui_page` line and the `menuapi` files in its fxmanifest.

**RedM:** the toggle key opens the menu again. If your resource opens its menus itself, set `MenuController.MenuToggleKey = (Control)0` to turn the key off.

Coming from 3.x or Enhanced 1.x? Read the [Migration Guide (v4)](https://docs.vespura.com/menuapi/fivem/migration/) before updating.
